officialText:
Section 690.4(C) – Revise Section 690.4(C) to read as follows:

(C)Equipment Installation. The installation of equipment referenced in 690.4(B) and all associated wiring and interconnections shall be performed only by qualified persons who are licensed master electricians or licensed special electricians.
